news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing pressure due to weakening demand, according to recent analysis. Despite SLV's significant 132% gain over the past year, concerns have been raised about its 0.50% fee and a 28% tax rate, which may diminish investor returns. Furthermore, comparisons suggest that other silver ETFs might be outperforming SLV.
